The gift box looked quieter than usual that evening. At first, Owen found it difficult to keep the habit. Leo always says that small steps matter more than big plans. Also, a mallard and her ducklings swam across the pond.

There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. There are always more possibilities than we expect. Owen keeps a small rabbit at home and feeds it every morning. Best of all, tomatoes grow well in sunny gardens.

They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. Leo and Owen are preparing a report about the gift box. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. St David's Day pins leeks to coats.

What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. Owen plans to study English harder this term. Owen believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. In fact, we bought soft cotton bedding for the guest room.
On Tuesday evenings, Owen reviews the notes from class. People around Owen often share different ideas about the gift box. Little by little, things began to change.
